verdict.rationale: Pulumi ships an official, well-documented CLI. Documented commands include `pulumi preview` (with `--import-file`), `pulumi import`, `pulumi do` and `pulumi api` for calling any Pulumi Cloud REST endpoint. Numeric exit codes are documented for scripts and CI/CD, and Pulumi positions this workflow for coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex and Cursor. Missing for 10: documented machine-readable (e.g. JSON) output or non-interactive agent mode, and independent hands-on corroboration of agents driving the CLI.
